dataset: PhysioNet Apnea-ECG 1.0.0, learning and test sets (real recordings only)
validation: leave-one-subject-out; all recordings of one person are held out together
subject_grouping: inferred from identical age, sex, height and weight in additional-information.txt
class_definition: apnea minutes >= 100 is apnea, < 5 is control, otherwise borderline (excluded)
ci_method: percentile bootstrap resampling subjects, 2000 resamples, seed 0
limitations: Domain shift: this model was trained on clinical ECG recordings from the PhysioNet Apnea-ECG database (32 people in a sleep lab), and it is applied to wrist-wearable nightly summaries. Accuracy on WHOOP data is not claimed and has not been measured. The task validated here is separating apnea-group recordings from control-group recordings, not finding apnea in the general public. Borderline recordings were excluded. The sample is small, so the confidence interval is wide. Subjects were inferred from matching age, sex, height and weight, which may not be exact. WakeSafe is a screening aid, not a diagnosis.
